Em Criar, escolhe «Txillada», prepara-a: In Create, choose “Txillada”, set it up as usual (title, type and, if you like, the entry price or the Fundraiser) and tap “Schedule”, next to “Start”. Choose the day (Today, Tomorrow, the following days or “Another day”, on the calendar) and the time, in 15-minute steps: at least 15 minutes ahead and at most 30 days from now. You can have up to 5 scheduled, at least 30 minutes apart. It appears on your profile, in your followers' “Upcoming” row and in the link you share, only to people who could see a Txillada of that type. On the card you see how many people asked to be reminded (not who), you change the title, day and time in “Edit” (the type, price and goal can't change) and cancel with “Cancel the Txillada”: anyone who asked for a reminder is notified. You get a notification 15 minutes before and another at the start time. “Start” becomes active 1 hour before; before that, “Start now” moves the time to now. If you don't start within 2 hours of the scheduled time, it expires.

Em Definições, Conteúdo e o teu algoritm: In Settings, Content and your algorithm, “Your posts”, turn off “Let people repost my posts”. If you delete the tcheka the sound came from, the sound loses its page and can't be used again; existing uses carry on. In a duet, your sound goes with your video, even with this option off.

It's Txillapp's artificial intelligence. Open it with the SuperTxill button in Messages or in Search. In “Chat” you ask where everyone's at, what places and events are nearby, whether any Txilladas are live, or ask for ideas for a plan or a caption; in “People for you” you see people with tastes like yours. It's free, with a limit of answers per day (and a monthly total for the whole app). An answer can take tens of seconds: meanwhile “is thinking…” shows, and you can close the screen and see the answer when you come back.
It is free and takes less than a minute.
É onde fica quem deve a quem: as dívidas: It's where you keep track of who owes whom: debts from “I'll owe you”, from rounds and the ones you create with “I owe you one”. Whoever owes taps “I've already paid” (they can add a photo and where it happened: nearby places first, or by name) and it only counts as paid once the other person confirms. The place isn't a check-in: it's the label “at Bar X”. If you're actually there (within 150 m) or one of you checks in with the place's QR code within the same hour, it gets the “✓ they were there” badge. The person owed can also “Forgive”. A gelada paid and confirmed counts towards both people's geleira level (3 points for whoever paid, 2 for whoever received it); requests on their own don't count.
É pedir a um amigo que te pague uma bebi: It's asking a friend to buy you a drink, Friday-style. Tap a drink in your geleira (or a friend's) and “Paga-me uma”, or tap the “Paga-me uma” icon on the person's profile (the hand with the mug), or the + in a chat and “Ask for a gelada”. The person replies “Let's go!”, “Not today” or “I'll owe you”. No money or vibes involved: it's a promise between friends.
É um destaque pago por um local perto de: It's a promotion paid for by a place near you, with the place's vibes, to show an event or a post. It always carries that label and the place's name. It's only shown to people aged 18 or over, at most 3 times a day for the same promotion, and in about 1 in every 11 posts in the feed. To choose them we use your approximate area (about 1 km) from Around you or your chosen city, without storing it. The place only sees totals, never who saw it. If you don't want to see a place's promotions, tap “Don't show promotions from this place”.
É uma frase curta, até 60 caracteres, qu: It's a short line, up to 60 characters, that appears above your photo in the top row of Messages for 24 hours. Anyone who can see it also sees it in the header of their one-to-one chat with you. You can add a song, a place, a GIF and the bubble colour, or make a note with just a song, just a place or just a GIF. You can have one note at a time.
É vídeo ao vivo no Txillapp. Em Criar, e: It's live video on Txillapp. In Create, choose “Txillada”, add a title if you like, choose the type (Public: anyone who can see your profile; For friends: people you follow who follow you back, or only your close friends, the same list as for mimos; Private: anyone who wants to join pays an entry fee in vibes) and tap “Start the Txillada”. The type can't be changed once it's started. Only people aged 18 or over, according to the account's date of birth, with a confirmed email can start one. Anyone who can see you sees the red “LIVE” ring on your photo and joins with one tap, and viewers comment, react and cheer. A Txillada link opens inside the app, full screen, including from a chat. Anyone who has a block with you never sees it. It lasts 4 hours at most.
